```{r}
library(tidyverse)

## 데이터 불러오기 
DJ <- read_csv("DATA/다우존스 과거 데이터.csv")
STOXX <- read_csv("DATA/유로 스톡스 50 과거 데이터.csv")
KOSPI <- read_csv("DATA/코스피지수 과거 데이터.csv")
```

```{r}
## 수익률을 소수로 변환하는 함수
convert_return <- function(x){
  x %>%
    str_replace_all("%", "") %>%
    as.numeric() / 100
}
```

```{r}
## Dow Jones
dj <- DJ %>%
  select(Date = 1, Close = 2, Ret_raw = 7) %>%
  mutate(
    Date   = ymd(Date),
    Return = convert_return(Ret_raw),
    Index  = "Dow Jones") %>%
  select(Date, Close, Return, Index) %>%
  arrange(Date)
```

```{r}
## Euro STOXX 50
stoxx <- STOXX %>%
  select(Date = 1, Close = 2, Ret_raw = 7) %>%
  mutate(
    Date   = ymd(Date),
    Return = convert_return(Ret_raw),
    Index  = "Euro STOXX 50") %>%
  select(Date, Close, Return, Index) %>%
  arrange(Date)
```

```{r}
## KOSPI
kospi <- KOSPI %>%
  select(Date = 1, Close = 2, Ret_raw = 7) %>%
  mutate(
    Date   = ymd(Date),
    Return = convert_return(Ret_raw),
    Index  = "KOSPI") %>%
  select(Date, Close, Return, Index) %>%
  arrange(Date)
```

```{r}
dim(dj)
dim(stoxx)
dim(kospi)
```
```{r}
## 월초 데이터가 아닌 데이터 제거 
dj <- dj %>%
  filter(day(Date) == 1)  # 0 또는 NA 제거
```

```{r}
## 전체 데이터
df <- bind_rows(dj, stoxx, kospi)
```

```{r}
ggplot(dj, aes(x = Date, y = Close)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Dow Jones Monthly Close",
       x = "", y = "Close") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(stoxx, aes(x = Date, y = Close)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Euro STOXX 50 Monthly Close",
       x = "", y = "Close") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(kospi, aes(x = Date, y = Close)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "KOSPI Monthly Close",
       x = "", y = "Close") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(kospi, aes(x = Date, y = Return)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "KOSPI Monthly Return",
       x = "", y = "Return") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(kospi, aes(x = Date, y = Return, fill = Return > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("red","blue"), labels=c("Up","Down")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels=scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(title = "KOSPI Monthly Return",
       x = "", y = "Return", fill="Direction") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
extreme <- kospi %>%
  filter(Return >= 0.1 | Return <= -0.1)
extreme

extreme %>%
  mutate(Year = year(Date)) %>%
  count(Year)

extreme_plus <- extreme %>%
  filter(Return >= 0.1)
extreme_plus

extreme_minus <- extreme %>%
  filter(Return <= -0.1)
extreme_minus
```

```{r}
library(forecast)
library(FinTS)   # ARCH
library(rugarch) # GARCH

## 시계열 데이터
ts_r <- kospi %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  pull(Return) %>%
  ts(frequency = 12)

## ACF/PACF
par(mfrow=c(1,2))
acf(ts_r, main="ACF")
pacf(ts_r, main="PACF")
par(mfrow=c(1,1))

## ARMA 모형 선택
fit_auto <- auto.arima(ts_r, 
                       stationary = TRUE, 
                       seasonal = FALSE,
                       max.p = 5, 
                       max.q = 5)
print(fit_auto)

## Ljung-Box test
lj <- Box.test(residuals(fit_auto), lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")
print(lj)

## ARCH test

arch <- ArchTest(residuals(fit_auto))
print(arch)

## GARCH(1,1)
spec <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model="sGARCH", garchOrder=c(1,1)),
  mean.model     = list(armaOrder=c(1,1), include.mean=TRUE),
  distribution.model="std"
)

fit_garch <- ugarchfit(spec, ts_r)
show(fit_garch)
```
